objective: make powershell manager truely awesome 100% coverage

coverage.scope: All production Rust files in src; no production-file exclusions or coverage-only alternate implementations
coverage.note: Measured with cargo-llvm-cov 0.9.1, nightly manifest 2026-09-29, rustc 1.101.0-nightly (2026-09-28), LLVM 23.1.1. All 27 production src files count: 5115/5115 lines, 513/513 functions, 5805/5805 regions and 1008/1008 branch outcomes. The strict full gate passed with exit 0. Test-only preview action overrides were removed; tests and production share action availability, geometry, storage, focus polling and tray-state logic.
coverage.native_environment: Explorer notification registration is rejected in the sandbox. Native tray and full coverage suite passed outside it on the normal desktop. Original tray-icon 0.19.3 also passed there; the vendored patch follows the documented structure contract and cleans registration failures.
